policy.automatic_grading: Use only explicit-source-answer-slide / explicit-source-displayed-answer or separately approved derived answers. Do not grade against null or proposed answers.

materials.analysis_en: Read Celsius temperatures; choose grad or gradi; interpret a five-day forecast.
Read common fractions and mixed numbers, with food and group-of-children examples.
Metric units, decimal measurements, equivalent units and fractions of a kilogram.
Two progressive word-building sequences: 123,655 and 130,568. Keep stages as evidence, not duplicate cards.
A clickable rainfall map, decimal readings and three multiple-choice questions requiring language review.
One page containing only the text Quizlet.com ghadd imtenni partijiet tal-ġisem; no body-part table is present in the rendered PDF.
Digits-to-words, words-to-digits, form selection, decimal quantities and fractions. Final listening task has no supplied stimulus.
Standalone, ordinary attributive and consonant-cluster forms of 3, 4, 5, 7, 8 and 9, with explicit answer slides.
English explanations, Maltese dual pairs and two exercise sets, including raster-only content.
Body parts, time and quantities; ten fill-in questions with answers displayed on the slides.
An ODT document with alternating numbered lists: four large integers and four written number prompts. Reusable pairs are grouped by exercise position.
Decades, fractions, decimal measurements, money and useful time expressions.
